facts.text: Snow left Sawmill (10,200 ft) 12 days earlier this year than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: Sawmill
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 14 (2024), May 12 (2025); 2023: readings jump by more than snow can

facts.text: At Sawmill (10,200 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 6.3 in, the lowest of three of the four seasons on file (2024 to 2026).

evidence.name: Sawmill
evidence.detail: 6.3 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 14.6 in (2024), 14.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 7 and July 10, carried from the melt-out dates at Bishop Pass (11,200 ft) and Sawmill (10,200 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Bishop Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 27, 900 ft below the pass; points to May 15 to July 10

evidence.name: Sawmill
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 1,900 ft below the pass; points to April 29 to July 9
